snapshot: WHO African Region. Health services are devolved to 47 counties; the national government runs financing through the Social Health Authority. Kenya is responding to imported Ebola cases linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

agenda.title: Containing Ebola and fighting travel bans
agenda.text: Kenya has confirmed Ebola cases linked to the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In November the ministry reported three weeks without new cases and a countdown to Ebola-free status. The government has asked WHO to intervene over travel restrictions; Africa CDC called Saudi Arabia's ban on Kenya unjustified.

agenda.title: Universal health coverage through the Social Health Authority
agenda.text: Two years in, the Social Health Authority has registered about 33 million people. Payment delays are the pressure point: faith-based hospitals are demanding billions of shillings in arrears, and the authority is adding controls against false claims.

agenda.title: Health data and digital systems
agenda.text: The Cabinet Secretary has announced a national health data intelligence centre.
